steps.content: Very well, you can see clearly now, and you can hear. The scorching body fluid, palmprints, wails, and struggle flow into your perception through the shackles.
You capture the darkest, most cunning one. Frail and in pain, it's devoured by fear. It's imprisoned, scared of making any missteps.

An unknown excitement begins burning. You can't tell whether it's a hunger or a desire for the truth. You step on the scorch marks and walk forward. Enduring both external and internal pain, you reach the edge of the vent following the drag marks.
This is its escape route. It hasn't gone too far. You'll find it!
<color=#dg1f1f><i>Ha... Ha... Ha...<color=#dg1f1f><i>
The screech echoes among the buildings of the Drifter Camp quarter. You don't see the huge monster you expect to find.
And karma has already caught up with you. The murmuring around you is becoming too loud to ignore.
Tens of thousands of people are still hiding from the visible contamination, yet they're traversing the burning filth unknowingly. Captured. Corrupted.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: The FAC decontamination force reports an unusual increase of residual contamination in the BR-004 lockdown area was observed two weeks ago.

steps.speaker: Furian
steps.content: A monster... A huge, burning one... It-It was howling... It grabbed me...

Countless voices swarm into your mind along the track. Filled with anxiety, suspicion, fear, and impatience, they make you light-headed. The entire Drifter Camp has turned into an enormous beating heart.
With the thunderous heartbeats comes a twisted voice.
<color=#dg1f1f><i>Hehehe... Haha... Coming back to life... Soon...<color=#dg1f1f><i>
<color=#dg1f1f><i>Give it back to me... Give it all back to me...<color=#dg1f1f><i>

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: <size=44>Show yourself!!!</size>

steps.speaker: Hecate & Hella
steps.content:
Chief!
Oi!
The Sinners drag you away quickly. Your body comes off the track. The shackles fall apart. You're next to that isolated and quiet vent again, safe and sound.
You want to go on with your search, but your body can't take it anymore. You kneel on the floor and begin vomiting.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: What's wrong? You were fine just now, until you suddenly ran off and started yelling and puking. What happened?

You wish you knew. The contamination here is already so severe, but the anti-Mania system still has no reaction at all. Your shackles sense nothing either... How does it conceal itself so perfectly? How long has it been hiding? Days? Years?
Regardless of how weak it may be now, it's undeniably the scariest among all the powerful Corpus you've seen.
